caption: The drawing consists of a square composition with a beige or light tan background, framed by a thin blue border. Dominating the center is a large circular floral motif with a red and white segmented inner disc, surrounded by blue jagged petals radiating outward. Four smaller red flowers with scalloped edges and white centers are positioned around the central motif, each attached by green stems and leaves. Along the left and bottom borders, a repeating pattern features larger red and white floral shapes with green leaves, interspersed with red-and-white scalloped semicircular elements bordered in teal. The entire drawing is detailed with fine linework, giving the appearance of quilting or embroidery in the background, with additional subtle floral designs lightly sketched within the beige space. The predominant colors are red, blue/teal, green, and white, all arranged symmetrically within a quarter section of the overall design, suggesting it could be a corner of a larger textile pattern.
title: Appliqued Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
